title: research-reconciliation: P0 research subskill 9/9 (completes family) + control 26 (sufficiency means synthesis)
objective: Build the terminal research subskill research-reconciliation, completing the nine P0 subskills: a concise SKILL.md whose question is 'do we know enough?' not 'what do we recommend?', returning a controlled disposition, never PASS/FAIL, holding RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT != IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZED. Add control 26 (earned, deferred from evidence-synthesis): a RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT record carries at least one finding. Correct the accounting error that mistracked control 15 (already enforced since RSR-004) as pending. Register IMPLEMENTED; badf-research stays DESIGNED.
business_value: Reconciliation is where research ends and hands off to a separate decision authority; requiring RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT to rest on synthesised findings stops a record from declaring the evidence enough while having synthesised nothing. Completing the family means every P0 research capability now has a governed contract.
in_scope: skill-registry entry research-reconciliation IMPLEMENTED with a real digest
acceptance.md control 26 row + control-15 accounting correction (already enforced since RSR-004)
root SKILL.md router (9 of 9); tests failing-first + mutation; own G07 self-dossier
out_of_scope: advancing badf-research off DESIGNED (the family now MEETS IMPLEMENTED/VALIDATED criteria, but the status advance is the operator's admission decision)
acceptance_criteria: research-reconciliation/SKILL.md exists, is concise, registry digest == sha256(source), status IMPLEMENTED
